summary: Preserved candidate 41e7ba79d5a83b5e3ddb4f43b733ed0820a04351 and corrected two independently reproduced gaps: abort-only mode now sanitizes logits before sampling, and full-NaN prefill aborts use the comprehensive cleanup path with cache insertion disabled.

tests.what_was_measured: At the exact candidate implementation, both regressions failed: abort-only preprocessing retained NaNs and prefill did not call the comprehensive cleanup helper. See raw/failing-before-clean.txt.

On gfx950, the candidate produced mask=[True], nan_after_preprocess=True and zero finite values for a 163840-wide row; after correction it produced mask=[True], nan_after_preprocess=False and 163840 finite -1e30 values. See raw/gpu-abort-only-before.txt and raw/gpu-abort-only-after.txt.

27 tests and 4 subtests passed, covering abort-only sanitization, full/partial row boundaries, prefill/decode behavior, cleanup hooks, no cache insertion, Mamba boundaries, and disaggregated prefill cleanup.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0; a 1x163840 GPU logits row was checked before and after the correction.
remaining_limitations: Kimi-K3 weights, Blackwell SM10x TP=8, the transient production NaN source, and multi-node serving were unavailable.
The hierarchical-cache guarantee was verified at the publication boundary (release with is_insert=False), not against a live external storage backend.

Speculative decoding remains unsupported for full-NaN request abort because verified logits rows require algorithm-specific request mapping; the reported production configuration had speculative decoding disabled.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
